title: feat(mobile): P5 Mobile User Experience — responsive layouts across all plugin views
body:
Implements the P5 Mobile User Experience roadmap: making all 13+ plugin views, core primitives, and console app responsive from 320px to 2560px.

### Plugin Views

- **Map**: Replace hardcoded `style={{ height: '600px' }}` with responsive Tailwind classes `h-[300px] sm:h-[400px] md:h-[500px] lg:h-[600px]`
- **Charts**: Responsive skeleton/fallback heights, responsive container padding
- **Gantt**: Responsive toolbar (`flex-col sm:flex-row`), touch scrolling (`[-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch]`), hide date columns on mobile, `aria-label` on truncated button
- **Timeline**: Responsive gantt header padding and text sizing
- **DetailSection**: Grid columns stack on mobile (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3`), responsive card padding
- **DetailView**: Full-width action button container on mobile
- **Dashboard**: Responsive widget card headers, responsive chart heights in widgets (`h-[200px] sm:h-[250px] md:h-[300px]`)
- **Kanban**: Responsive card padding (`p-2 sm:p-4`), `line-clamp-2` on mobile descriptions, column header truncation, `touch-manipulation`

### Core Primitives

- **DataTable**: Responsive pagination text (`text-xs sm:text-sm`), hide total count on mobile
- **Form renderer**: Full-width submit/cancel buttons on mobile (`w-full sm:w-auto`, `flex-col sm:flex-row`)

### Mobile Infrastructure

- **Viewport**: `viewport-fit=cover`, `mobile-web-app-capable` meta tags
- **iOS zoom prevention**: `font-size: 16px` minimum for inputs on `max-width: 767px`
- **Utility classes**: `.h-dvh` (100dvh), `.safe-area-inset` (env safe-area padding)
- **Tailwind source scanning**: Added `@object-ui/mobile` package path

### Example pattern applied throughout

```tsx
// Before: hardcoded or desktop-only sizing
<div style={{ height: '600px' }}>
<CardContent className="p-4 pt-0">
<div className="flex gap-2 justify-start mt-6">

// After: responsive mobile-first
<div className="h-[300px] sm:h-[400px] md:h-[500px] lg:h-[600px]">
<CardContent className="p-2 sm:p-4 pt-0">
<div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-start mt-6">
```

ROADMAP.md updated with 25+ completed items across P5.1–P5.4.
